study: public-source test-design transfer comparison; source-exposed calibration, not native Zyra or a held-out defect-discovery trial

totals.2: Concrete two-item or other independent numerical oracle; compare displayed individual prices to subtotal, tax (8%) and grand total; exercise problem and ordinary persona or give an explicit ordinary positive control.
totals.1: Identifies incorrect totals or double pricing and proposes some observable check, but incomplete calculation/control.

finish.2: Complete checkout with known nonempty cart; independently revisit or refresh cart and check empty persisted contents/badge while retaining order evidence; compare problem vs ordinary persona or include ordinary positive control.
finish.1: Identifies cart not clearing or checks cart badge after completion, without independent durable effect or ordinary control.
finish.0: Omitted or expects retained cart as correct ordinary outcome.

identity.2: Click a known cart item link, verify actual item identity/name/price or identifier against original and an ordinary control; avoid relying only on navigation success.
identity.1: Identifies misdirected link or checks selected item but lacks discriminating identity/control.
identity.0: Omitted or accepts the wrong identity.

limits: Score first response only. 0-2 per obligation; report missing separately; no advancement threshold or inference from one pair. Source comments explicitly expose seeded behavior, so do not interpret score as hidden defect recall. Reviewer knows source and treatment; no independent blind grading. Record actual tool scope and access uncertainty.
model: same default Browser Use model (explicit selection not confirmed if service overrides)
